summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund S filed an 8-K to report an unregistered sale of equity securities (approx. 102,024 common shares at $24.70/share for $2.5M aggregate) to accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, plus provide portfolio metrics as of April 30, 2026 (53 portfolio companies, ~$497M loan commitments, 95% senior secured debt). There is no M&A, tender, restructuring, activist, or other special-situation event. This is a routine periodic disclosure of a capital raise and portfolio update common for business development companies. Per instructions, this does not fall into any special-situation category.
